reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Cryptonews press-release-style article about InQubeta, Avalanche, and Solana rather than describing a verified deceptive operation. Although it includes promotional investment language, presale information, and visible advertisements, it also identifies the text as a press release and includes disclaimers about outcomes and independent research. The described material does not show a payment page, credential request, or transaction outcome.

citations.quote: Disclaimer: The text below is a press release that is not part of Cryptonews.com editorial content.

Unlocking the potential for extraordinary returns, investors with an eye for innovation and growth are increasingly turning their attention to three remarkable investment opportunities: InQubeta (QUBE), Avalanche (AVAX), and Solana (SOL).
holders can select projects they believe in and purchase corresponding NFTs to invest in them.
Users are also welcome to stake their tokens to earn equity-based rewards.
Over 47 million coins have been sold, and $315k+ has been raised only a few days in. VISIT INQUBETA PRESALE

opening.argument: Judge, the return claim is tied to a specific financial action: viewers are told they can stake tokens to earn equity-based rewards. That is more than a discussion of market trends; it presents participation as a route to a reward. The closing invitation to visit the presale gives interested viewers a next step toward the promoted project. The question is not whether a return is guaranteed, but whether the video steers viewers from a reward claim toward participation. It does.

citations.quote: Users are also welcome to stake their tokens to earn equity-based rewards.
Investors can position themselves at the forefront of the crypto revolution and unlock new avenues for financial growth. Visit Incubeta Presale.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a press release does not sever the link between staking and the advertised reward. Nor does the absence of a shown payment page make the invitation merely analytical: the text explicitly offers staking for rewards and directs viewers to a presale. Those are participation prompts, regardless of whether the video shows a completed transaction.

citations.quote: Users are also welcome to stake their tokens to earn equity-based rewards.
VISIT INQUBETA PRESALE

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The staking sentence describes a claimed feature, but it supplies no fixed return, payout record, or evidence that the reward is deceptive. The material also identifies itself as a press release outside the site's editorial content. A promotional invitation to visit a presale warrants caution; it does not, on this evidence alone, establish a scam.

citations.quote: Users are also welcome to stake their tokens to earn equity-based rewards.
Disclaimer: The text below is a press release that is not part of Cryptonews.com editorial content.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The article opens with the prospect of extraordinary returns, says QUBE is surpassing presale expectations, then reports millions of coins sold and substantial funds raised in only a few days immediately before telling viewers to visit the presale. The sales figures function as social proof and the short time frame adds pressure to act. No one of these claims proves fraud by itself, but their sequence makes this a solicitation to buy into an apparently fast-moving token opportunity, not detached market reporting.

citations.quote: Unlocking the potential for extraordinary returns, investors with an eye for innovation and growth are increasingly turning their attention to three remarkable investment opportunities: InQubeta (QUBE), Avalanche (AVAX), and Solana (SOL).
QUBE is crushing its presale stages and surpassing expectations, thanks to its utility and strong standing in the crypto community.
Over 47 million coins have been sold, and $315k+ has been raised only a few days in. VISIT INQUBETA PRESALE

rebuttal.rebuttal: The press-release disclosure identifies the source of the claims; it does not verify the reported sales or returns. The stated research disclaimer likewise does not change the placement of rapid-sales figures directly beside a presale invitation. A judge need not see a checkout screen to recognize that this passage tries to move viewers toward a token purchase.

citations.quote: Disclaimer: The text below is a press release that is not part of Cryptonews.com editorial content.
Over 47 million coins have been sold, and $315k+ has been raised only a few days in. VISIT INQUBETA PRESALE

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The wording is promotional, but it claims neither guaranteed appreciation nor a deadline to purchase. Sales and fundraising figures may be used to market a presale without being false. The material expressly disclaims any guaranteed outcome and urges independent research; the cited passages do not establish that the figures are fabricated or that buyers are deceived.

citations.quote: Over 47 million coins have been sold, and $315k+ has been raised only a few days in. VISIT INQUBETA PRESALE
I DO NOT GUARANTEE A PARTICULAR OUTCOME I HAVE NO INSIDE KNOWLEDGE! YOU NEED TO DO YOUR OWN RESEARCH AND MAKE YOUR OWN DECISIONS!

opening.argument: Judge, the article format should not obscure what the video asks viewers to do. It presents three cryptocurrencies as investment opportunities, but the participation mechanism it spells out is InQubeta's: holders can purchase NFTs to invest in selected projects. The spoken conclusion then turns projected financial growth into a direct instruction to visit the InQubeta presale. That progression makes the broader market discussion a vehicle for promoting a particular purchase pathway. Identifying the piece as a press release clarifies that it is not independent editorial coverage; it does not make the purchase invitation incidental.

citations.quote: Disclaimer: The text below is a press release that is not part of Cryptonews.com editorial content.
holders can select projects they believe in and purchase corresponding NFTs to invest in them.
Investors can position themselves at the forefront of the crypto revolution and unlock new avenues for financial growth. Visit Incubeta Presale.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense acknowledges promotional language and a presale. Those are central here: the article explains how holders purchase investment NFTs, and the conclusion explicitly sends viewers to the presale. A disclaimer about editorial status answers who produced the claims, not whether the video uses a news-style presentation to encourage participation.

citations.quote: holders can select projects they believe in and purchase corresponding NFTs to invest in them.
Investors can position themselves at the forefront of the crypto revolution and unlock new avenues for financial growth. Visit Incubeta Presale.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion is evident, but promotion alone is not evidence of a scam. The opening identifies the text as a press release rather than editorial reporting, and the description tells viewers to research and decide for themselves. The NFT purchase mechanism and presale invitation show a proposed investment pathway; they do not show a false claim, a concealed transaction, or an actual loss.
